content:
lena: quick idea: what if the edge early-acks and returns a signed resume token immediately after headers so clients can stream without holding a long TCP session?

lena: rough flow: client -> edge (202 + token) -> client streams body. if client disconnects, it replays using token to resume or request deterministic replay from backend. :thinking:

derek: so edge promises to accept the request and orchestrate reassembly? how is this different from our existing resume tokens?

maria: the key is determinism. token encodes canonical route/version/start_seq so any compatible backend can replay stream without the edge holding per-connection state.

ben: main risks: replay safety (side effects), billing attribution, token theft. need strict idempotency and binding to auth.

lena: plan is to only issue tokens for routes marked resumable or inherently idempotent. token bound to tenant key + route + nonce.

derek: token shape? opaque or structured so upstream can validate without edge state?

maria: proposal: token = base64url(hmac(k_edge, route||version||nonce||start_seq||expiry)); metadata blob signed with same key carries route/version/start_seq/ttl. Backend validates HMAC and reconstructs offsets.

ben: handling partial side effects is tricky. if backend emitted effects before start_seq, replay could duplicate them. need backend checkpoints or require resume for read-only/generation calls only.

lena: two options: 1) support resume only for non-side-effecting endpoints; 2) for stateful endpoints, require backend idempotency API that accepts resume-token to reconcile duplicates.

ops-bot: config reminder: feature flag edge.resume_early_ack and route-level resumable: true are required.

maria: operational: backpressure. early-ack means clients may stream large bodies before backend accepts. we must gate with a small write window (e.g., 64KB) and short-lived admission credits while waiting for backend reservation.

derek: agreed. allow small burst (64KB) pending backend accept. if backend rejects, edge aborts and returns final error; no billing.

ben: telemetry needed: tokens_issued, tokens_used, token_aborts, avg_resume_latency, memory_pressure_early_ack. also per-tenant resume_rate to avoid floods.

lena: security: tokens must be bound to TLS client identity or API key. rotate signing keys regularly. avoid logging raw decoded tokens.

maria: rollout: 1) implement signer/validator on edge; 2) route opt-in + autoscaler safety; 3) backend deterministic-replay endpoint; 4) canary on read-only generation routes.

derek: billing: defer charge until backend accepts OR forwarded_bytes > 8KB to avoid charging for abandoned early-acks.

lena: agree: charge_on = backend_accept OR forwarded_bytes > 8KB.

ben: debugging: surface token in traces but scrub tenant ids when decoding. add lookup from token->trace id.

maria: can we POC early-ack + 64KB buffer + signed token + no-charge-until-accepted? I'll prototype backend API shape.

lena: I'll draft a short PR and design note with failure modes: token theft, mid-replay multi-client race, backend partial-commit. add jittered exponential backoff for client resume attempts and server-side per-tenant resume rate limits.

ops-bot: created task EDGE-1243 to track POC and infra changes.
